clauses.text: A first-level appeal must be received within 180 days of the denial date.
An appeal must identify the claim, state the denial reason being disputed, cite the policy clause the provider relies on, and include the parts of the record that support each statement.
A change to claim data, such as a modifier, a diagnosis pointer or an authorization number, is a corrected claim and not an appeal. Corrected claims follow the limits in policy TESS-TF.
An appeal of a denial with reason code 50 is decided by a plan clinician. The treating clinician may request a peer-to-peer discussion within 14 days of the denial date.
An appeal that restates the claim without new evidence is dismissed.
